title: Add accepted and rejected generated examples
summary: Added an accepted model-authored additive-zero equation animation, exposed it as the 42nd KP editor descriptor, and verified visible semantic token motion in Chromium. Added rejected renderer-keyframe and incomplete-lifecycle examples with concrete repair guidance, plus a generic safe ordered-label-to-KaTeX annotation path.
